crossRefs.note: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.
A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called “The Holy Way”. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will…
but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.
But he who endures to the end will be saved.
But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.
Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in…
Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole…

translations.web: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
translations.bsb: The highway of the upright leads away from evil; he who guards his way protects his life.
translations.kjv: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
translations.asv: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: He that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
